## Smart Caption Glasses for the Deaf - AugmentOS

caydengineer (Cayden Pierce)

240Likes

16KViews

2025Feb 20

AugmentOS has built-in live captions for the deaf and hard of hearing. They're fast, accurate, and 100% free. You can buy any pair of supported glasses (Even Realities G1, Vuzix Z100, Mentra Mach1) and instantly get high quality captions overlaid on your vision.
Check it out: https://AugmentOS.org/captions
